profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer|Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Currently pursuing a master's degree in computer engineering at Syracuse University, I am honing my technical knowledge to complement practical experiences. Committed to continuous learning, my goal is to contribute innovative solutions to complex challenges within the field of technology, all while elevating team performance and product excellence.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Owego, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer supporting the Future Long Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA MV75) initiative, contributing to the development and sustainment of advanced embedded avionics software for next-gen Army aviation platforms. Responsibilities include designing and supporting real-time embedded software, collaborating with hardware and systems engineering teams, ensuring compliance with aerospace software standards, and helping deliver resilient, secure, and mission-ready capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Contribute to embedded software development and integration for FLRAA systems. 
- Support debugging, testing, and verification of real-time software components.
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex system challenges.
- Adhere to strict aerospace, safety, security, and quality standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Devices · Embedded Software · Python (Programming Language) · Information Technology Infrastructure · Embedded C · C++

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer at Peraton, I support mission-critical systems for federal clients by maintaining and enhancing legacy mainframe applications. My responsibilities primarily involve development in COBOL, with supporting tasks in JCL (Job Control Language) and CICS (Customer Information Control System). I contribute to both ongoing maintenance and modernization efforts, occasionally interfacing with Java-based components in a hybrid technology environment.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, debug, and maintain COBOL programs running in a mainframe environment.

- Create and manage batch processes using JCL.

- Support transaction processing and screen-based interfaces using CICS.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability and compliance.

- Analyze existing codebases to improve system performance and scalability.

- Document technical specifications and participate in code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Government · Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Security Research · Cyber Security Risk · Java · IBM Mainframe

positions.title: Player
positions.description: The NCL competition provides students with experience in solving real-world cybersecurity challenges such as identifying hackers from forensic data, pen testing and auditing vulnerable websites, recovering from ransomware attacks, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Ethical Hacking · Wireshark · Hashcat · Cryptography · Encoding · Kali Linux · Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) · Communication · Penetration Testing · Metadata Management

positions.title: Engineering Technical Specialist II
positions.locationName: Greene County, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Serve as a linchpin in the software engineering life cycle, making substantial contributions to daily tasks that propel product enhancement forward. 
▪	Migration from Jira Server to Jira Data Center: Led a successful migration project from Jira Server to Jira Data Center, a critical initiative spanning six months.
▪	Played a key role in planning, executing, and troubleshooting the migration process, ensuring a seamless transition for the entire organization. 
▪	This project significantly enhanced system scalability by 30% and ensuring 100% uptime during the transition. Implementations made raised our project completion rate from 60% to 100% ensuring no software is released without child tasks being completed. 
▪	Security Board and Threat Modeling: Actively served on the Security Board at Raymond, rose the completion rate of Security Reviews related to vulnerabilities to 90%.
▪	Collaborated closely with the IT department to address and mitigate audit vulnerabilities. Played a pivotal role in enhancing the organization’s security posture by applying a comprehensive threat model using the Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool. 
▪	Successfully contributed to closing out 100% of Raymond’s Security Reviews. This strategic involvement resulted in the identification and mitigation of potential security risks related to Raymond’s ISO 27001 standards. By proactively contributing to security initiatives, assisted in creating a resilient and secure IT environment for the telematics department.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Problem Solving · C++ · Linux · Jira · Bitbucket · Scripting · Gitlab · Threat & Vulnerability Management · Jama · Atlassian Bamboo

positions.title: Application Development and Maintenance UPS LOG Extension
positions.description:
Worked closely with systems analysts, engineers and computer programmers to understand limitations, develop capabilities and resolve software problems. Managed all phases of application design – from coding and prototyping through system testing, integration and deployment.

During my time at Cognizant/UPS, I developed several key skills and accomplishments, including:
    • UPS Data Capture Team: Served as a member of the UDC application team, developing strategies to ensure compliance with new industry standards for all UPS related devices, and electronic exchange.   
    • Lead SPSF Support:  Regarded as a key member of Smart Package Smart Facility support team handling all UPS locations. Reduced wait time by 50% and solved 100% of issues within 48 hrs.  by developing custom software solutions that help customers make more informed decisions and improve their knowledge and use of the applications and devices. Handled tickets using Service Now software. 
    • Back End Support:  Troubleshooted enhanced programs using Java, C and C++, contributing to solutions that streamlined processes, increasing accuracy, and lowering costs. Helped develop back-office application that saved client more than $125,000 annually when testing devices and printers.
positions.insights: Skills: VSAM · CICS · IBM Db2 · JCL · Problem Solving · COBOL · Engineering

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description:
Completed assignments using Mainframe application skills – COBOL Arithmetic Verbs, Sequence Control Verbs, File Handling Verbs, Call Verb, Sort, String Handling, VSAM Datasets, AIX, DB2 Test Environment SQL’s and DB2 Embedded SQL Application Programs.
During my time at Genspark, I developed several key skills and accomplishments including:
    • Back End Development: Created the back end of a banking domain using COBOL language to access with VSAM. 
    • Clusters and DB2 Database: Created Test Environment using SPUFI tool in DB2-Dealt with DB2 Locks to manage concurrent access of applications towards the database access.
    • Embedded Application Development:  Obtained solid understanding of embedded application development by creating, testing, and deploying applications on custom hardware.
